description: Send a new email from one of your inboxes and return the created message (id, thread_id, delivery_status). Starts a new thread; to continue a conversation use reply_to_message so threading headers are set. Recipients matching a block rule are refused and addresses that previously bounced are suppressed. Pass client_id to make retries idempotent. Errors: 400 missing fields, 402 plan send limit reached, 413 message over 10 MB, 422 all recipients blocked or suppressed.

attachments.description: Optional file attachments. The whole message must stay under 10 MB once encoded.

content_type.description: MIME type, e.g. "application/pdf". Inferred from filename when omitted.

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient, e.g. "report.pdf".

bcc.description: Optional BCC addresses (not visible to other recipients).

client_id.description: Optional idempotency key you choose (e.g. a UUID). Resending with the same client_id returns the original message instead of sending again.

html.description: Optional HTML body. text is used as the plain-text alternative.

inbox_id.description: Id of the sending inbox (from list_inboxes).

text.description: Plain-text body. Provide text, html, or both.

to.description: Recipient email addresses; at least one.

name: send_message
title: Send email
